scope: All 33 active scientific repositories are placed in one ecological research system. Series remain distinct ownership units; evidence-mode overlap is tracked separately from scientific dependency.
system_surface: VARIATION <-> STATE <-> RECORD <-> INFERENCE <-> NEXT OBSERVATION <-> FIELD RETURN

node_roles.hotarubukuro: focal Campanula flower-colour geography publication system
node_roles.azami: present-day thistle image-phenomics and environmental structure
node_roles.EAzami: public-data evolutionary history and recurrence/depth discrimination
node_roles.aza3: own-data ancestry × phenotype × cytotype history discrimination
node_roles.chun: evolutionary-time and molecular flower-colour recurrence programme
node_roles.shimahotarubukuro: focal Izu Campanula floral phenotype divergence
node_roles.v3: reference-guided information refinement before record-entry/semantic coarsening
node_roles.rec: pre-entry exposure and record censoring method
node_roles.sch: shared-coordinate functional conflict and compromise geometry
node_roles.bita: differentiated-coordinate architecture gain and mechanism-allocation boundary
node_roles.payoff: population-game abstraction of compromise, invasion, coexistence and architecture differentiation
node_roles.sdmr: environmental-coordinate admission and leakage-free SDM method
node_roles.odsp: multidimensional niche geometry and state-resolved prediction
node_roles.theouni: meta-theory, admission grammar and portfolio registry

within_series_state_transitions.surface: shared-coordinate compromise -> middle world -> differentiated architecture
within_series_state_transitions.firewall: PAYOFF is a population-game lift, not a fourth chapter.

cross_series_relations.object: reference-refinement methods line migrated from PolliPi
retained reference information before record-entry selection
WHAT to measure <-> WHERE to look
biological sampling need -> bounded search geography
candidate patch -> field truth and individual intake

system_cycle: construct or retain a state representation
audit reference information, record entry and record semantics
test whether the state/proxy earned endpoint-relevant status
license only what current evidence can report
choose what to measure and where to look next
return new field evidence to the empirical programme
non_edges: shared evidence mode is not a scientific dependency
shared philosophy alone is not a scientific edge
shared organism or dataset does not transfer results
PAYOFF abstraction does not make SCH/BALANCE/BITA one empirical dataset
V3 information order does not make PolliPi/InsePi/REC/TNOA one validation pipeline
later evidence does not retroactively validate an earlier closed, failed or bounded gate
